how_to.heading: How to Find Your Perfect Fit
how_to.note: Every measurement in this guide is of the garment laid flat, not your body.

steps.title: Grab a layer you love
steps.detail: A vest or light jacket that fits how you want. Lay it flat.

steps.title: Measure and compare
steps.detail: Match it to the chart below. Chest decides your size.

steps.title: Pick your size
steps.detail: No layer to compare? Use the To Fit column: pick the size for your body chest.

footer: Garment measurements are of the vest laid flat. To Fit is the body chest each size is cut to fit. A manufacturing tolerance of ±1 inch applies.
